title: Knockout Portuguese Yautia Hash
description: A fresh and shaggy Portuguese dish featuring yautia, perfect for curing hangovers, made with dairy-free friendly ingredients and served in a scallop shell vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the diced yautia, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add the yautia mixture, cooking until the yautia is tender and lightly browned.
Stir in the non-dairy milk and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Spoon the yautia mixture into scallop shell vessels.
Bake the yautia hash in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until lightly browned and crispy on top.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
Let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
